children.name: Neosilurus novaeguineae
children.description: Neosilurus novaeguineae is a freshwater eeltail catfish described by Max Weber in 1907.

children.name: Neosilurus equinus
children.description: Neosilurus equinus, the southern tandan, is a species of fish in the eeltail catfish family.

children.name: Neosilurus hyrtlii
children.description: Neosilurus hyrtlii, commonly known as Hyrtl's catfish or Glencoe tandan, is a species of catfish found across northern Australia, from the Pilbara to southeastern Queensland.

children.name: Neosilurus mollespiculum
children.description: Neosilurus mollespiculum, commonly known as softspine catfish, is a species of catfish native to the Burdekin River system in Australia.

children.name: Neosilurus brevidorsalis
children.description: Neosilurus brevidorsalis, commonly known as shortfin tandan or shortfin catfish, is a species of catfish native to lakes, swamps and rivers in Far North Queensland and New Guinea.

children.name: Neosilurus gloveri
children.description: Neosilurus gloveri, commonly known as Dalhousie catfish, is a species of catfish native to Dalhousie Springs in central Australia.

children.name: Plotosus lineatus
children.description: Plotosus lineatus, commonly known as the striped eel catfish, is a species of catfish belonging to the eeltail family Plotosidae.

children.name: Plotosus canius
children.description: Plotosus canius is a species of eeltail catfish, in the genus Plotosus, native to the Indian Ocean, the western Pacific Ocean and New Guinea.

children.name: Plotosus japonicus
children.description: Plotosus japonicus, commonly known as the Japanese striped eel catfish, is a species of eeltail catfish belonging to the family Plotosidae.

children.name: Paraplotosus butleri
children.description: Paraplotosus butleri, commonly known as the sailfin catfish, is a species of catfish in the family Plotosidae.

children.name: Cnidoglanis macrocephalus
children.description: Cnidoglanis macrocephalus is a species of catfish (order Siluriformes) of the family Plotosidae, and is the only species of the genus Cnidoglanis.

children.name: Tandanus tropicanus
children.description: Tandanus tropicanus or the wet tropics tandan The species, which grows to length of about , has a cylindrical body tapering to a thin, eel-like tail.
